Graduate Catalog
Graduate Catalog
The Graduate Catalog is an official publication of UA Little Rock, revised annually and published in July each year. It provides information about degree programs, course offerings, and academic regulations.
Limited electronic copies of previous catalogs may be found on the catalog archive website, and hard copies of every year are kept in the Office of Records and Registration.
Each college within UA Little Rock reserves the right to change graduation requirements for its program. Students should meet regularly with their academic advisors to ensure they are aware of any changes in graduation requirements that may apply to them.
UA Little Rock reserves the right to change, phase out, or discontinue any program at any time for the University’s best interest.
